title: 📅 Планы на выходные
description: Расскажи, что ты обычно делаешь по выходным (Present Simple) и что ты планируешь на эти выходные (Present Continuous for Future).

sections.name: 🕖 Обычно (Present Simple)
prompts: On Sundays I usually wake up at …
I always help my parents about the house.
I often play computer games on Saturdays.
I sometimes go to the cinema with my friends.
I rarely read books at the weekend.

sections.name: 📅 Планы на эти выходные (Present Continuous for Future)
prompts: This weekend is different! Tomorrow I am visiting …
In the evening, we are having …
On Sunday morning, my friend and I are going to …
We are meeting at … at 5 PM.
I am really looking forward to …!
